episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the importance of incremental improvement in real estate skills and the power of consistency in content creation. He shares insights on leveraging social media algorithms, particularly on Instagram and TikTok, and emphasizes the value of YouTube as a search engine for real estate marketing. The conversation provides actionable strategies for agents to enhance their personal brand and lead generation efforts.
